## Characters Section

The textbook's Characters lesson on printed pages 22–23 presents these items apart from the New Words list:

- **Stroke forms (p. 22):** 横折斜钩 (horizontal-turning-slanting hook) and 弯钩 (crooked hook). Example characters: **飞** (fēi, to fly), **风** (fēng, wind), **狗** (gǒu, dog), **猫** (māo, cat).
- **Single-component characters (pp. 22–23):** **手** (shǒu, hand), **丈** (zhàng, a unit of length; originally an old person with a staff), and **夫** (fū, adult man; husband).
- **Radicals (p. 23):** **木字旁 / 木** (wood/tree radical, often associated with plants; examples **杯** bēi, cup/glass, and **椅** yǐ, chair) and **立刀旁 / 刂** (knife radical, associated with knives or cutters; examples **别** bié, to leave/part, and **到** dào, to arrive).
